governance.note: Byte-faithful re-solve of the neiso-25 fullstop-override keeper config (scripts/run_calibration_full.py --iso NEISO --year 2023 2024 2025 --commitment --ct-deployment --hydro-backfill-year 2024 --hydro-eia930-monthly; identical on plant_level_fleet, offer_curve_by_group, gas overlays, outage_source=historic, scarcity_pricing_enabled=false, pumped_storage_dispatch_adder=null->0). Purpose: surface and root-cause the C5b storage-throughput metric. NO model dispatch change and explicitly NO storage knob: the PS under-cycle is downstream of the collapsed scarcity tail (the keeper's documented winter-oil / monthly-AGT residual), not a storage defect, so a PS adder/duration/RTE tuned to the 2.08 TWh actual is rejected (claude.md #1/#11/#12). The only code change is a measurement-coverage gate in eia_loader.load_eia_hourly_benchmark that drops an EIA-930 storage breakout series reporting <50% of the year's hours (NEISO PS 2023=0%, 2024=14.8% -> SKIPPED), so a partial reporting vintage is no longer scored as a full-year actual; it generalises the existing all-NaN guard and is keyed on input coverage, not on any residual. All active levers trace to measured inputs (CAMPD unit-outage windows, EIA-860 BTM CHP pull-out, measured F923 monthly gas + AGT hub basis, measured EIA-930 interchange). See docs/multi-iso/neiso-ps-undercycling-diagnosis-2026-06.md.

unledgered_known_misses.classification: MODEL MISS — deliberately NOT in the exceptions ledger
unledgered_known_misses.reason: The 2025 EIA-930 PS series is complete (8736/8760 h), so this under-cycle is a real model defect, NOT a partial-vintage measured-input limitation, and is therefore not ledgerable as an accepted caveat (rubric C5b: only under-cycling against a *partial* series may be accepted). It is left out-of-tolerance on purpose so the determination reads NOT-YET. Root cause is the collapsed price/scarcity tail (model >$200 hours 0/0/14 vs actual 72/43/290; 2025 max $258.98 vs actual ~$1110), itself downstream of monthly-AGT winter-gas granularity (gas_hub_basis_daily=false) and scarcity_pricing_enabled=false: PS round-trip breakeven needs an intraday price ratio >1.25 (RTE 0.80) but the model's median daily ratio is 1.15, so PS arbitrages only ~50 days/yr. Fix belongs to the scarcity/winter-gas workstream (daily AGT spot upload U4; or NEISO operating-reserve scarcity pricing), NOT the storage formulation. This block is informational only (the scorer ignores it); see docs/multi-iso/neiso-ps-undercycling-diagnosis-2026-06.md.
